limits: The previous 211.696ms activation sample cannot be retrospectively subdivided with new timestamps.
Write-entry to decoded-reply receipt includes native write, IPC, framing and app-reader scheduling; it does not isolate kernel write completion.
Removing one possible rendezvous per completed native command is a structural reduction, not a measured millisecond improvement.

Installation baseline is not an attended CPU-pressure crossing/endurance trial. A new user trial is required to identify the largest remaining span and establish tail latency or recurrence improvements.
